visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a beige turtleneck under a grey knit sweater and black trousers, is shown from the chest up. He holds a large brown plastic watering can with both hands, tapping its textured surface rhythmically with his fingers as if it were a drum. His facial expression is one of intense focus and slight furrowed brows. The background is a plain indoor wall with a white air conditioning unit visible. (2) The scene shifts to a full-body shot of the same man standing in a bedroom. He is positioned near a small, 2-foot Christmas tree on the floor. He continues to hold the watering can and a wooden spoon, tapping the can while looking down at the tiny tree. The room contains a bed with beige sheets and a window with an arched frame. (3) A sharp cut transitions to a festive living room scene where four people, including the man from before and an elderly woman, are gathered around a large, brightly lit Christmas tree. They are all wearing holiday-themed red sweaters—some with comical muscle prints—and festive hats. They wave enthusiastically at the camera with wide smiles. Digital sparkle effects and warm indoor lighting create a celebratory atmosphere.

The sound design focuses entirely on the percussive texture of the manual tapping, emphasizing the 'instrumental' use of a non-musical object. Simultaneously, a group of male and female voices erupts in synchronized cheering and festive shouting. The vocal intensity is high with extremely positive valence, blending with the loud, bright music track to create a dense, celebratory acoustic environment.
